description: This file defines the internal class SiloRoleBasedPlacementDirector which implements the IPlacementDirector interface. It manages placement of silos based on their roles within the Orleans runtime, specifically selecting compatible silos for grain activation based on their role and status.

classes.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacementDirector
classes.description: An internal class responsible for directing placement of silos based on their roles within the Orleans runtime, ensuring that grains are activated on silos with matching roles and active status.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Handles the placement logic for activating a grain, selecting a compatible silo based on role and status, and optionally using a placement hint if provided.
